@goodandready/dsh-session-search.desc.header: Configure search limits, snippet sizes, and query deadlines for the autonomous agent session_search tool.
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.error.maxResults: Max results must be an integer between 1 and 100.
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.error.snippetLength: Snippet length must be an integer between 50 and 1000.
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.error.timeoutMs: Timeout must be an integer between 1000 and 120000 ms.
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.field.maxResults.desc: Maximum matching sessions returned per query (1–100, default: 20).
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.field.snippetLength.desc: Character length of context excerpt sliced around best match (50–1000, default: 200).
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.field.timeoutMs.desc: Cooperative search deadline in milliseconds (1000–120000, default: 30000).
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.subtitle: Core SQLite FTS5 agent memory query engine
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.title: Session Search
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.updater.desc: Session Search uses the host core SQLite FTS engine. Plugin updates are applied via the DSH CLI: dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-session-search@latest
@goodandready/dsh-session-search.updater.title: Updater & Maintenance
